function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Content must in <file_content>...</file_content> in reply body BEFORE the file_write call (not args). Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed

function.name: workspace_open
function.description: Open a local folder as the active workspace. Use to explore project directories, browse codebases, and get file tree overview.

path.description: Absolute path to the folder to open as workspace.

function.name: workspace_list
function.description: List files and folders in the workspace or a specific path. Supports glob pattern filtering.

path.description: Path to list. Defaults to active workspace root.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files, e.g. *.py or *.md.

function.name: workspace_search
function.description: Search for files by name within the workspace. Use when you only know part of a filename.

query.description: Search query matching against file names.

path.description: Directory to search. Defaults to active workspace root.

function.name: remote_connect
function.description: Connect to a remote server via SSH. Use before remote_exec, remote_file_read/write. Supports key and password auth.

name.description: Connection name, auto-generated if host provided.

function.name: remote_exec
function.description: Execute a shell command on a connected remote server with streaming output.

server.description: Server name. Omit to use first active connection.

function.name: remote_file_read
function.description: Read a file from a connected remote server.

server.description: Server name. Omit to use first active connection.

function.name: remote_file_write
function.description: Write content to a file on a connected remote server.

server.description: Server name. Omit to use first active connection.

function.name: remote_list_dir
function.description: List directory contents on a connected remote server.

server.description: Server name. Omit to use first active connection.

function.name: media_info
function.description: Get detailed info about a media file: type, size, dimensions, duration, format, pages. Works with images, videos, audio, PDF, documents, archives.

function.name: content_search
function.description: Search file contents by regex pattern (powered by ripgrep). Essential for exploring codebases: find function defs, usages, TODOs, etc.

path.description: Directory or file to search. Defaults to workspace root or cwd.

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each match.

function.name: git_status
function.description: Show working tree status (porcelain format). See what files are modified, staged, or untracked.

path.description: Repo path. Defaults to workspace root or cwd.

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show git diff of working tree changes. Use to review what the agent (or user) has modified before committing.

staged.description: Show staged changes instead of unstaged.

path.description: File or directory to diff. Omit for all.

path_repo.description: Repo path. Defaults to workspace root or cwd.

function.name: git_log
function.description: Show recent commit history.

path_repo.description: Repo path. Defaults to workspace root or cwd.

function.name: file_revert
function.description: Revert a file to its most recent backup (created automatically before file_patch/file_write). Use when agent modifications went wrong.

function.name: media_extract
function.description: Extract content from media: text from PDF/DOCX/XLSX, preview thumbnail from images/videos, or full metadata.

function.name: computer_screenshot
function.description: Take a screenshot of the user's screen. Returns a base64-encoded PNG image and screen dimensions. Use this to see what the user sees before performing computer actions like mouse clicks or typing.

region.description: [Optional] [x, y, width, height] region to capture. Omitting captures the full primary display.

display.description: [Optional] Display index to capture (1-based). Default is primary display.

function.name: computer_open
function.description: Open a desktop application in the foreground and optionally open a URL or file with it. Use this instead of merely claiming that a browser or app was opened. On macOS, this tool verifies the requested app actually becomes frontmost.

application.description: Application name, e.g. 'Google Chrome', 'Safari', 'Finder', 'Visual Studio Code'. For browser tasks, set this explicitly so foreground activation can be verified.

target.description: [Optional] URL or file path to open with the application. If application is omitted, opens the target with the system default handler.

wait_timeout_ms.description: [Optional] How long to wait for the application to become frontmost on macOS.

function.name: computer_action
function.description: Perform mouse, keyboard, or application actions on the user's computer. Use after computer_screenshot. Supported actions: open_app (requires text: application name, e.g. 'Google Chrome', launches and brings to foreground), left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, middle_click, mouse_move (requires x,y), type (requires text), key (requires text as key chord, e.g. 'cmd+a', 'return'), scroll (requires direction: up/down/left/right, amount: 1-100), wait (requires duration in seconds). Coordinates reference the most recent screenshot.

action.description: Action: open_app (launch app, requires text), left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, middle_click, mouse_move, type, key, scroll, wait, left_mouse_down, left_mouse_up

text.description: Text to type (for type action) or key chord (for key action, e.g. 'cmd+a', 'return').

duration.description: Duration in seconds for wait action (0-100).
